title: Worth hearing
intro: New episodes of your watched shows, briefed for you. HEAR ones are reasoning or stories worth listening to.
empty-hint: Turn this on and pick a few shows to watch.
no-hear: Nothing to hear right now. Check back after the next update.
enable-hint: Checks your watched shows on a schedule and briefs new episodes, up to a daily cap. Needs AI connected in Settings → AI.
login-required: Automatic briefs need PodFetch without a login: the app can't sign in by itself in the background. You can still brief episodes one by one.
no-shows: No shows yet. Add a podcast first.
cap-hint: The most episodes briefed in one day, across all watched shows.
cap-invalid: The daily cap must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
estimate-none: Nothing new to brief right now with these settings.
